clineCopilotChat.dynamicModels.enabled.markdownDescription: Fetch the Cline catalog live instead of shipping a fixed list. Retired models disappear and new ones appear on the next refresh. Use **Cline Copilot Chat: Refresh Model List** to refresh on demand.

clineCopilotChat.dynamicModels.refreshHo.markdownDescription: Hours the live model list stays cached before it is re-fetched. Minimum `0.25` (15 minutes).

clineCopilotChat.dynamicModels.catalogBa.markdownDescription: Base URL for the Cline catalog endpoints (`/api/v1/ai/cline/models` and `/api/v1/ai/cline/recommended-models`). Change only for testing or a proxy.

clineCopilotChat.enabled.markdownDescription: Register the Cline provider. Set to `false` to remove Cline from the Language Models list and all model pickers (like deleting the provider in GitHub Copilot's Manage Language Models). Models you previously configured stay in your language-models config so they come back if you re-enable. Requires a window reload to take effect.

clineCopilotChat.clinePass.enabled.markdownDescription: Register the ClinePass provider. Set to `false` to remove ClinePass from the Language Models list and all model pickers (like deleting the provider in GitHub Copilot's Manage Language Models). Models you previously configured stay in your language-models config so they come back if you re-enable. Requires a window reload to take effect.

clineCopilotChat.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for Cline Copilot Chat completions.

clineCopilotChat.maxTokens.description: Optional max output token override. Use 0 for model default.

clineCopilotChat.debugReasoning.description: Write provider reasoning_content to the Cline Copilot Chat output channel.

clineCopilotChat.stripThinkTags.markdownDescription: How to handle think tags in model output.

clineCopilotChat.thinking.qwenBudget.markdownDescription: Optional thinking budget for Qwen models.

apiKey.title: Cline API Key
